name: logon-failure
description: A rejected logon. Proves a bad credential ends the run after exactly one request with a printed diagnostic naming the likely cause -- including the SAML-only-user trap -- and a clean zero-asset return rather than an abort or a misleading empty-tenant success.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.

log_contains: cyberark-epm: check the username and password; SAML-only users cannot use this endpoint
